title: Mardi Gras today and marching clubs
summary: Williams says there are more bands now, including school bands, and the marching clubs are old.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I was interested, you were talking before about Carnival and how it's changed. Were there more people, you said there are more bands now than they used to be?
Oh, yes. See, like all these school bands be on the Mardi Gras parade, you didn't used to see that. They got more musicians than I had since they've ever had since they've been a war.
But what about all these marching clubs? Do they used to march? Yeah.

They're going to march. The Garden District going up. The Denny Shade School going up. The Illinois Club going up. Buses going up. They had the phone that day, but they can't go on Canal Street. They cut up and gone to Canal Street over six years ago.
They turned off on the part or something.
Well, did they used to be war clubs like that in the old days or about the same numbers?
About the same number. All these is old clubs. They're all old clubs.
